messages:
Nina: Quick kickoff  need a one-pager + 3 battlecard knockdowns for May launch. Keep it sprint-friendly.

Diego: Got it. I'll do 3 short competitor lines: CloudX, LLMAPI, InfraCo.

Rae: SDR one-pager will be 2 lines positioning, 3 pain/rebut bullets, and qualifying Qs. I'll drop draft by 3pm.

Nina: Routing rule ask: tag leads mentioning 'benchmark', 'latency', or 'SLA' and route to sdr-bench queue. Ops, possible?

Ops: Yes. Will stage a regex rule and surface match score. Push to prod after 24h smoke.

Diego: Battlecard v1 bullets: CloudX  pricing variance; rebut: predictable unit economics + batching controls. LLMAPI  easy access, no deploy parity; rebut: same API across hosted/dedicated/private. InfraCo  ops burden; rebut: managed runtime + migration support.

Rae: Adding methodology caveat to every claim: "measured on dedicated pools, quant profile Q3" per legal.

Nina: Perfect. Action: @Diego finish bullets by noon, @Rae one-pager by 3pm, @Ops stage routing. Review at 15:30. Thanks :rocket:
